cards.definition: CAMI sponsored a concert that included a Gershwin song without copyright clearance. The court held CAMI liable because it knew the concert lacked clearance, even though CAMI did not directly put on the concert.
It expanded the scope of liability by establishing that indirectly involved parties could still be liable.
Universal argued that Sony's Betamax recorder infringed copyright because users recorded Universal's works. The court ruled in Sony's favor.
It established that manufacturers are not liable for infringement when their products have substantial non-infringing uses, such as time-shifting.
Grokster offered file-sharing software used to download copyrighted files and earned advertising revenue. It was held liable because it encouraged users to infringe.
It established that companies could be liable when they encourage customers to use their products for infringement.
Protects original works of authorship, such as novels, movies, and songs; encourages the creation and distribution of creative works; and is automatically granted to the creator for life.
Protects inventions, designs, and processes; encourages innovation and commercialization; requires an application; and lasts about 20 years.
Specific circumstances in which it is legal to reproduce a copyrighted work without the copyright holder's permission.
What is the purpose and character of the use? Examples include commentary, criticism, and teaching.
What is the nature of the work being copied? The guide notes that nonfiction is often acceptable.
How much of the work is being used?
How will the use affect the market?
Follows two categorical imperatives: act only from moral rules that you can will to be universal moral laws, and treat others as ends in themselves rather than only as a means to an end.
An act is right or wrong to the extent that it increases or decreases the total happiness of affected parties, following the principle of utility or greatest happiness principle.
Adopt the moral rules that, if followed by everyone, would create the greatest increase in total happiness for all affected parties.
The right action is what a virtuous person would do when acting in character under the circumstances. Virtuous traits help a person flourish and be truly happy, following the golden mean.
Morality consists of mutually beneficial rules for how people treat one another that rational people agree to follow on the condition that others follow them too.
A contract that is clearly stated, such as laws or terms of service.
A contract that is implied rather than necessarily codified into law, such as social norms and customs.
The first programmable electric digital computer.
The number of transistors doubles every two years.
Understanding that people and their core values are worthy of respect.
A right that is guaranteed by leaving the person alone.
Social and economic inequalities must be arranged to provide the greatest benefit to the least-advantaged members of society.
A patent-holding company that makes money by filing lawsuits to enforce its intellectual property rights.
A right that benefits society.
To inform the public.
